question: Should official Android Settings expose full admin-gated Skills enable/disable and ClawHub install management, or should Android remain read/search-only until maintainers sponsor a narrower mobile management surface?
rationale: This PR promotes Android from inspection to global Gateway mutation and ClawHub install UX, which is a product direction choice even after the mechanical admin-gating and protocol fixes are made.

options.title: Approve admin-gated management
options.body: Sponsor Android parity with Control UI, but require effective admin-scope gating, generated protocol artifacts, green lint, and real Android proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to read/search
options.body: Keep installed-skill search/status and ClawHub browsing while leaving install and global enable/disable to web, desktop, or CLI for now.

options.title: Pause the surface
options.body: Hold or close this branch until maintainers decide whether Android Settings should own skills management.

recommendation.title: Approve admin-gated management
recommendation.body: Sponsor Android parity with Control UI, but require effective admin-scope gating, generated protocol artifacts, green lint, and real Android proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about Android product surface, with Gateway scope owners as reviewers for the admin boundary.
